summary: A new non-face-to-face conversational channel operated through a third-party messaging vendor for existing retail customers. Transaction values are capped at CAD 1,000 and payee additions have a cooling period, but channel-specific device and session monitoring is not yet in place and the vendor's role in message handling needs assessment.

dimensions.narrative: Existing transfer product on a new channel.
New non-face-to-face channel on a consumer messaging platform.
Low values, capped; existing e-transfer scenarios apply.
Messaging vendor sits in the transaction path.
OTP and PIN over a third-party messaging channel; no device monitoring yet.

claims.text: Non-face-to-face channels require authentication, identity verification and behavioural monitoring proportional to value.

citations.quote: behavioural monitoring proportional to transaction value

claims.text: The new channel must be mapped to an active monitoring scenario before launch.

citations.quote: Every new transaction type, channel and destination country must be mapped to at least one active monitoring scenario before launch

claims.text: A vendor in the payment path is a critical vendor requiring due diligence before engagement.

citations.quote: Third parties that process payments, hold customer data or perform compliance functions are critical vendors

claims.text: Controls may reduce residual risk but do not eliminate inherent risk.

citations.quote: Controls may reduce residual risk but do not eliminate inherent risk
